title: The Strange Affair of Patrick De La Cerda
description:
Patrick De La Cerda was happily engaged to Jessica Devnani, and things were going great right up until the moment Patrick De La Cerda was found in a horrifying way. Was it linked to a very shady character from Jessica Devnani's past, Gregory Bender?
